AboutMe.title: Behind the Code
AboutMe.paragraph1: Hi! I am Alejandro Martinez Rivera, though my friends call me Alex or Ale. I am a Software Engineer specializing in software architecture and design, dedicated to creating innovative and tailored solutions that address real-world needs. My approach combines thoughtful design with a deep understanding of user requirements to deliver impactful software.
AboutMe.paragraph2: I thrive on solving challenges and turning ideas into functional, efficient systems that make a difference. Whether it is crafting custom tools for businesses or collaborating on unique projects, I am driven by the goal of making technology work for people.

Experience.title: Experience
Experience.description: My background combines corporate software engineering with independent product development. Alongside my internships building internal enterprise tools and automation workflows, I co-founded 4LL Code Soft—a collaborative studio where we design and deliver custom web, desktop, and mobile solutions tailored to real business operations.

4ll.summary: Designing and developing end-to-end web, desktop, and mobile applications for local businesses, translating operational needs into scalable software.

caterpillar.summary: Built internal applications, interactive Power BI dashboards, and automated workflows with Power Apps & Power Automate, cutting manual reporting time by ~40%.

toter.summary: Developed and deployed a Visual Basic & MySQL desktop system to manage inter-plant cargo shipments, reducing part loss by 30%.
